theorem QOU.BraidKnot.atomic_braid_polynomial_integral (Z N : ℕ) :
∃ (p : Polynomial ℤ) (E : HabiroExpansion p), ∀ (m : ℕ), (E.coeff m).natDegree ≤ m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_expansion_atomic (p : Polynomial ℤ) :
∃ (E : HabiroExpansion p), (∃ (M : ℕ), (∀ m ≥ M, E.coeff m = 0) ∧ M * (M - 1) ≤ 2 * p.natDegree) ∧ ∀ (E' : HabiroExpansion p) (m : ℕ), E.coeff m = E'.coeff m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.not_habiro_termination_bound_old :
¬∀ (p : Polynomial ℤ) (E : HabiroExpansion p), ∃ (M : ℕ), (∀ m ≥ M, E.coeff m = 0) ∧ M * (M + 1) ≤ 2 * (p.natDegree + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_termination_bound (p : Polynomial ℤ) (E : HabiroExpansion p) :
∃ (M : ℕ), (∀ m ≥ M, E.coeff m = 0) ∧ M * (M - 1) ≤ 2 * p.natDegree

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_bound_aux (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ) (hb : ∀ (m : ℕ), (b m).natDegree ≤ m) (N : ℕ) :
(∀ m ≥ N, b m = 0) → ∃ (M : ℕ), (∀ m ≥ M, b m = 0) ∧ (M = 0 ∨ tri (M - 1) ≤ (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, b m * qPochhammer Polynomial.X m).natDegree)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_expansion_unique (p : Polynomial ℤ) (E1 E2 : HabiroExpansion p) (m : ℕ) :
E1.coeff m = E2.coeff m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_expansion_exists (p : Polynomial ℤ) :
Nonempty (HabiroExpansion p)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_exists_aux (K : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℤ) :
(∀ (n : ℕ), tri K ≤ n → p.coeff n = 0) → ∃ (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ), (∀ (m : ℕ), (b m).natDegree ≤ m) ∧ (∀ m ≥ K, b m = 0) ∧ p = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range K, b m * qPochhammer Polynomial.X m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion.reconstructs_of_le {p : Polynomial ℤ} (E : HabiroExpansion p) {N : ℕ} (hN : E.supportBound ≤ N) :
p = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, E.coeff m * qPochhammer Polynomial.X m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiroSum_eq_zero_imp (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ) (hb : ∀ (m : ℕ), (b m).natDegree ≤ m) (N : ℕ) :
∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, b m * qPochhammer Polynomial.X m = 0 → ∀ m < N, b m = 0

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.coeff_top_ne_zero (b : Polynomial ℤ) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (K : ℕ) :
(b * qPochhammer Polynomial.X K).coeff (b.natDegree + tri K) ≠ 0

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.coeff_habiroSum_eq_zero (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ) (hb : ∀ (m : ℕ), (b m).natDegree ≤ m) (K n : ℕ) :
tri K ≤ n → (∑ m ∈ Finset.range K, b m * qPochhammer Polynomial.X m).coeff n = 0

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.leadingCoeff_qPochhammer_X (m : ℕ) :
(qPochhammer Polynomial.X m).leadingCoeff = (-1) ^ m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.natDegree_qPochhammer_X (m : ℕ) :
(qPochhammer Polynomial.X m).natDegree = tri m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.qPochhammer_X_ne_zero (m : ℕ) :
qPochhammer Polynomial.X m ≠ 0

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.natDegree_one_sub_X_pow (k : ℕ) :
(1 - Polynomial.X ^ (k + 1)).natDegree = k + 1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.one_sub_X_pow_ne_zero (k : ℕ) :
1 - Polynomial.X ^ (k + 1) ≠ 0

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.le_tri (m : ℕ) :
m ≤ tri m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.two_mul_tri (m : ℕ) :
2 * tri m = m * (m + 1)

def QOU.BraidKnot.tri :
ℕ → ℕ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_step_zero (p : Polynomial ℤ) :
∃ (a₀ : ℤ) (p₁ : Polynomial ℤ), p = Polynomial.C a₀ + (1 - Polynomial.X) * p₁

noncomputable def QOU.BraidKnot.habiro_expansion_const (c : ℤ) :
HabiroExpansion (Polynomial.C c)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion.reconstructs {p : Polynomial ℤ} (self : HabiroExpansion p) :
p = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range self.supportBound, self.coeff m * qPochhammer Polynomial.X m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion.coeff_vanish {p : Polynomial ℤ} (self : HabiroExpansion p) (m : ℕ) :
m ≥ self.supportBound → self.coeff m = 0

abbrev QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion.supportBound {p : Polynomial ℤ} (self : HabiroExpansion p) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion.deg_bound {p : Polynomial ℤ} (self : HabiroExpansion p) (m : ℕ) :
(self.coeff m).natDegree ≤ m

abbrev QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion.coeff {p : Polynomial ℤ} (self : HabiroExpansion p) :
ℕ → Polynomial ℤ

constructor QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion.mk {p : Polynomial ℤ} (coeff : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ) (deg_bound : ∀ (m : ℕ), (coeff m).natDegree ≤ m) (supportBound : ℕ) (coeff_vanish : ∀ m ≥ supportBound, coeff m = 0) (reconstructs : p = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range supportBound, coeff m * qPochhammer Polynomial.X m) :
HabiroExpansion p

structure QOU.BraidKnot.HabiroExpansion (p : Polynomial ℤ) :
Type

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.qPochhammer_one {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (u : R) :
qPochhammer u 1 = 1 - u

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.qPochhammer_succ {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (u : R) (m : ℕ) :
qPochhammer u (m + 1) = qPochhammer u m * (1 - u ^ (m + 1))

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.qPochhammer_zero {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (u : R) :
qPochhammer u 0 = 1

noncomputable def QOU.BraidKnot.qPochhammer {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (u : R) :
ℕ → R
